title: SocialCrawl — Unified Social Media Data API
description: Call any of 381 SocialCrawl endpoints across 48 platforms, run a universal cross-platform social search, trigger a Prism composite, drive the web-scraping suite, or manage scheduled monitors — all with your own SocialCrawl API key. Pick a platform and resource, add parameters, and run. The 'List'/'Search' actions need no key.

apiKey.title: SocialCrawl API key
apiKey.description: Your SocialCrawl API key (looks like `sc_…`). Get one free — 100 credits, no credit card — at https://www.socialcrawl.dev. Required for 'Run API request' and 'Check credit balance'.

action.title: Action
action.description: What the Actor should do. 'Run API request' is the default. Everything below it is free: the four 'Learn the API' actions cost 0 credits (they read the API's own live docs surface, so they need a key but never charge), and the four 'Browse' actions answer from the Actor's bundled catalog and need no key at all. New to SocialCrawl? Start with 'Quickstart'.
enumTitles: Learn: Quickstart — how to configure and call the API (free)
Learn: Endpoint guide — full instructions for one endpoint (free)
Learn: Agent context — the llms.txt corpus for your AI agent (free)
Learn: Check for updates — is this Actor's catalog still current? (free)
Browse: List endpoints for a platform (no key needed)
Browse: Search all endpoints by keyword (no key needed)
Browse: List pricing for endpoints (no key needed)

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: The platform to query. Choose 'Universal Search' to fan out across many social platforms in one call, 'Prism' for cross-platform composites, or 'Monitors' to schedule any endpoint to re-run on a cadence. For 'Quickstart' and 'Agent context' this scopes the answer to one platform — tick `allPlatforms` for the whole API.

resource.title: Resource (endpoint)
resource.description: The endpoint to call on the chosen platform, e.g. `profile`, `profile/videos`, `video/comments`. For Universal Search use `everywhere`. For Monitors use `create`, `list`, `get`, `runs`, `timeseries`, `pause`, `resume`, or `delete`. Also names the endpoint for action 'Endpoint guide'. Not sure? Run action 'Search endpoints' first, or 'Endpoint guide' for exact instructions.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Parameters as key–value pairs, e.g. {"handle": "charlidamelio"} for a TikTok profile, {"url": "https://..."} for comments, or {"query": "electric cars"} for Universal Search. Run 'List endpoints' to see every parameter with its type, allowed values, bounds and an example.

allPlatforms.title: Cover every platform
allPlatforms.description: The Platform dropdown can never be empty, so tick this to ignore it. 'List endpoints' / 'List pricing' then cover the WHOLE catalog; 'Quickstart' / 'Agent context' return the whole-API answer instead of a platform-tailored one.

query.title: Search query (for 'Search endpoints')
query.description: Keyword(s) to search the whole endpoint catalog with — e.g. `comments`, `product reviews`, `transcript`, `ad library`. Only used by action 'Search endpoints'.

format.title: Agent-context format
format.description: Only used by action 'Agent context'. `markdown` returns the llms.txt corpus (also saved to the key-value store as AGENT_CONTEXT.md, ready to paste into a system prompt or commit to a repo). `json` returns the same content as a structured object.

maxItems.title: Max items (auto-pagination)
maxItems.description: Leave at 0 for a single request. Set it higher and the Actor follows the API's `next_cursor` until it has this many items. ⚠️ EACH PAGE IS A SEPARATE BILLED CALL against your SocialCrawl credits. Only applies to endpoints where `paginatable` is true — run 'List endpoints' to check.

maxPages.title: Max pages (safety cap)
maxPages.description: Hard ceiling on how many billed requests auto-pagination may make, whatever `maxItems` says. Capped at 500.

dryRun.title: Dry run (price it, don't call it)
dryRun.description: Validate the request, resolve the exact endpoint and method, and report what it would cost — without calling the API or spending a single credit. Useful before a large auto-paginated run or a metered endpoint.

method.title: HTTP method (optional)
method.description: Leave blank for the default — almost every endpoint is GET and resolves automatically. Only set this for the stateful Web Scraping routes that share one resource across several verbs (e.g. `monitors/{monitor_id}` is GET, PATCH, or DELETE). For path-template resources, supply the id (e.g. `job_id`, `monitor_id`, `session_id`) as a normal parameter.

idempotencyKey.title: Idempotency key (optional)
idempotencyKey.description: Optional. An opaque, client-generated string (UUIDv4 recommended). Reusing it within 24h replays the original response and charges 0 new credits — safe for retries. Applied to the first page only when auto-paginating.

baseUrl.title: API base URL (optional)
baseUrl.description: Advanced — override the API origin. Defaults to https://www.socialcrawl.dev. Leave blank unless you have a reason to change it.
